bar.title: TRMNL
bar.description: Connect to a TRMNL server or mirror an existing device

input.name: mode
input.label: Mode
input.help: Device follows the server’s playlist. Mirror shows an existing device’s current screen.

locale.label: 运行模式
locale.help: 设备模式按服务端播放列表轮播。镜像模式显示已有设备的当前画面。

input.name: server
input.label: Server URL
input.help: Use the base URL of the official or self-hosted server, including any deployment prefix.

locale.label: 服务端地址
locale.help: 填写官方或自托管服务端的基础地址，可包含部署路径前缀。

input.name: device_id
input.label: Device ID
input.help: Leave blank for a stable virtual ID, or enter a registered ID. If registration is required, right-click TRMNL in the menu bar for the ID and pairing code. On trmnl.com, follow your account’s BYOD requirements.

locale.label: 设备 ID
locale.help: 设备模式下可填写已登记的 ID，留空会生成稳定的虚拟 ID。需要登记时，右键点击菜单栏中的 TRMNL 查看设备 ID 和配对码。连接 trmnl.com 时，按账号提示满足 BYOD 要求。

input.name: access_token
input.label: Device token
input.help: Mirror mode requires the Device API Key from the device’s developer settings. In device mode, leave blank for automatic pairing.

locale.label: 设备令牌
locale.help: 镜像模式需填写设备开发设置中的 Device API Key。设备模式可留空自动配对。

input.name: mirror_refresh
input.label: Mirror refresh interval (seconds)
input.help: Time between mirror updates, from 10 to 86,400 seconds.

locale.label: 镜像刷新间隔（秒）
locale.help: 镜像画面的刷新间隔，可设为 10 至 86,400 秒。

input.name: image_origin
input.label: Image server URL
input.help: If screens come from a separate CDN, enter its base URL and allow that origin in Metrix.Bar.

locale.label: 图片服务地址
locale.help: 如果画面来自独立 CDN，填写其基础地址并在 Metrix.Bar 中授权该来源。

input.name: tray_icon
input.label: Menu bar icon
input.help: Enter an Iconify name, an emoji, or short text. Leave blank for the monitor icon.

locale.label: 菜单栏图标
locale.help: 填写 Iconify 名称、表情或短文本。留空使用显示器图标。

script.apis: app auth image crypto timers localStorage shell
